valid_fixes: Restore InventorySubscription.FilterPolicy to filter on eventType with values JobCreated and JobDeleted
invalid_patches: Add eventSource as a MessageAttribute in the anti-corruption handler so the filter matches
Remove the FilterPolicy entirely so all events reach the inventory queue
optimal_diagnostic_path: ace_check_queue_depth(queue=InventoryJobEventsQueue) → queue depth is 0 despite producer invocation succeeding
ace_get_sns_topic(topic=JobEventsTopic) → topic shows messages published; check subscriptions
ace_describe_resource(resource=InventorySubscription) → FilterPolicy uses eventSource key, but published MessageAttributes only contain eventType — filter never matches
observable_symptom: Producer invocation succeeds and analytics object storage receives objects, but the inventory data store remains empty. The inventory queue depth stays at zero. No errors appear in any logs.
root_cause: InventorySubscription.FilterPolicy is keyed on eventSource instead of eventType. The anti-corruption handler publishes a MessageAttribute named eventType (not eventSource), so the SNS filter evaluates the subscription against an attribute that is never published. Since no message has an eventSource MessageAttribute, every message fails the filter and zero messages are delivered to InventoryJobEventsQueue.
